records.title: Your life, for mine
records.body: 1d6 + DEX piercing. (1/turn) Take 1 wound to make the die crit.

fields.moreInfo: Used by the most wicked cheats.

records.title: Can spells and abilities exceed the normal action cap?
records.body: Spells/Abilities like Heart’s Fire and Electrocharge can bring you above your normal action cap.

records.title: Which skill should I use to Assess?
records.body: Whatever skill you use must make sense based on the circumstances. For example, if you’re close to an enemy, you could use Might to create an opening, but against an enemy that is far away, that may not make sense. Or if you want to ask a question about the weaknesses of an elemental, you’d likely use Arcana.

records.title: How does Barrier of Wind interact with Defend?
records.body: When an ally is attacked at Range, if you upcast Barrier of Wind, you can Defend to protect them provided they are within Reach.

records.title: How do defensive and reaction spells affect their trigger?
records.body: Reactions resolve before their trigger. So if an attack was made but the attacker is now [Poisoned](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fconditions%23poisoned)/[Frightened](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fconditions%23frightened)/[Blind](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fconditions%23blind)/etc. the attack is rolled again, but taking into account the condition (rolling with disadvantage). You can only cast 1 defensive spell each time you Defend (e.g., Frost Shield OR Alacrity, not both on the same round).

records.title: How does dual wielding different weapons work?
records.body: Roll dice for both weapons and choose either result instead (the 1/round limit still applies). Attacking with [advantage](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fadvantage-disadvantage)? Add an extra die for one of the weapons.

records.title: Does Create an Opening affect flat damage or d44, d66, and d88 abilities?
records.body: These abilities do not have a Primary Die so they are unaffected by Create an Opening. Instead, the next attack that has a Primary Die would be affected.

records.title: Is Grappling considered an attack?
records.body: Yes. Anything that negatively impacts your enemies is an attack and impacted by Rushed Attacks (in this case the enemy would gain stacking [advantage](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fadvantage-disadvantage) on their save as the rushed penalty).

records.title: What about half-elves and other mixed ancestries?
records.body: Mix the ancestries however makes sense in your world. You can pick one ancestral bonus and use it instead of both, or use both half as effectively or half as often.

records.title: Can I Interpose and Defend at the same time?
records.body: Yes! As long as you have enough actions to spend, you can Interpose and Defend at the same time. However, you won't be able to do either reaction again until your next turn ends since each is limited to 1/round.

records.title: Can you Interpose against an area-of-effect attack?
records.body: If one can be pushed out of the affected area, AoE attacks can be Interposed.

records.title: How does Interpose work with conditional attacks?
records.body: If it makes sense that the hero could push their ally out of the way of the attack (e.g., the ally isn’t Grappled), it works as normal—the Interposing hero suffers the damage and other effects as normal.

records.title: Whose KEY does a spell or ability use?
records.body: Whenever a spell or ability uses KEY, it refers to the caster’s attribute, not the target’s.

records.title: Does a Legendary monster act after every creature's turn?
records.body: What if a mob of 100 commoners attack a dragon, does it get to move at light [speed](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fmovement) after each one of their turns?! No. Only after hero’s turns. Commoners, minions, and other followers are not heroes. As the GM, use your best judgment and feel free to nix any rule that your table doesn’t like or that doesn’t make sense in the world.

records.title: What if I have negative STR during a Field Rest?
records.body: Your frail body doesn’t recover as quickly as others. Subtract your STR from each HD you expend.

records.title: How should turn order work when playing virtually?
records.body: You can go in webcam order, alphabetically, or however is easiest to track!

records.title: How long should a Safe Rest take?
records.body: If your table prefers to largely skip [downtime](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fdowntime) activities and narrate past a week of resting, that’s okay too! For a more realistic convalescence time, 1 week per [wound](slate:nimble-nexus%40d8a939aa69752d92c05ba9760b60b2dadae07485%3A%3Arule%2Fwounds) recovered may make more sense.

records.title: Can you Defend against Warding Bond?
records.body: Yes, this counts as being attacked so you can Defend against it as normal.

records.title: Can my character be a wealthy noble?
records.body: That’s fine, but your character only has access to this amount of gold for now. Why your wealth is currently inaccessible is up to you and your GM; unlocking your full riches could be a great quest!

terms.preview: **Blind.** Can't see. Attacks against you have advantage, and your attacks have disadvantage.
**Silenced.** Cannot cast spells or use other abilities that require speaking.
**Charged.** Become Charged when you take lightning damage. Lasts 1 minute or until combat ends.
**Smoldering.** Has no effect on its own; some spells and abilities gain additional effects against Smoldering creatures.
**Bloodied.** At half HP or less.
**Charmed.** Sees the charmer as an ally. Charmer has advantage on social interactions with you.
**Dazed.** Heroes: lose 1 action; monsters: can perform one less action on their next turn.
**Frightened.** Disadvantage on rolls when source of fear is nearby; speed halved when moving closer to it.
**Grappled/Restrained.** Cannot move. Attacks against you have advantage.
**Grappled/Restrained.** Cannot move. Attacks against you have advantage.
**Grappled/Restrained.** Cannot move. Attacks against you have advantage.
**Hampered.** Any creature with actions or movement reduced (e.g., Dazed, Grappled/Restrained, Prone, Slowed, in Difficult Terrain).
**Incapacitated.** Can't do anything. Attacks against you have advantage, and melee attacks that hit, crit.
**Invisible.** Cannot be seen. Your attacks have advantage, and attacks against you have disadvantage.
**Petrified.** Incapacitated. Immune to most damage except from large explosions, picks, or similar tools.
**Poisoned.** Disadvantage on rolls (typically, healing ends).
**Prone.** Movement costs twice as much, and disadvantage on attacks. Melee attacks against you have advantage; Ranged have disadvantage. Spend 3 spaces of Speed to stand up.
**Slowed.** Speed halved during your next turn.
**Taunted.** Disadvantage on attacks except against the most recent taunter.
**Wounded.** Has any Wounds (typically 6 Wounds and a hero is dead).
**Dying.** At 0 HP. Actions are limited to 1 and Concentration is broken. Attacking or taking damage causes additional Wounds.
Hit Points (HP) represent your ability to endure damage. Damage reduces your HP (minimum 0). At 0 HP you gain 1 Wound and the Dying condition.
Wounds are serious injuries and a long-term gauge of how close you are to death. HP recovers quickly; Wounds take many days (typically 1 per Safe Rest). At 6 Wounds, you die.
Hit Dice (HD) represent your ability to recuperate from minor injuries and are spent to regain HP. Your HD max starts at 1 and increases each level.
Roll with disadvantage when the situation is grim: roll 1 extra die of the same type and remove the highest.
Roll with advantage when in a favorable situation: roll 1 extra die of the same type and remove the lowest.
Attempt to grab a creature within Reach with at least 1 arm free. On a failed STR or DEX save (DC 10+STR or DEX), a target your size or smaller is Grappled.
Attempt to grab a creature within Reach with at least 1 arm free. On a failed STR or DEX save (DC 10+STR or DEX), a target your size or smaller is Grappled.
Some activities require Concentration to maintain — only one at a time. When critted while concentrating, make a DC 10 STR save or Concentration breaks. Automatically broken at 0 HP or Incapacitated.
Tiered spells require mana to cast (mana cost = tier). Cantrips are free. Spend additional mana to upcast a spell and make it stronger.
Time not spent adventuring. Spend Downtime to retrain abilities, gather information, buy & sell, craft, socialize, or pursue personal goals.
**Catch Breath** (10 min): Expend Hit Dice and add STR to regain HP. **Make Camp** (8 hrs): Take max HD value instead of rolling. **Safe Rest**: Recover all HP, HD, and class resources.

A character's Speed is how fast they can move (default: 6 spaces). On a grid, 1 square ≈ 5 ft. You can move through allies but can't end in an occupied space.
Gain a level while Safe Resting after completing a challenging quest or adventure. Increase max HP, Hit Die max, and skill points, and gain new class features.
